reference_sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  -- one row per month with sessions, 2024 and 2025
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', session_start) AS DATE) AS month, COUNT(*) AS sessions
  FROM sessions
  WHERE session_start >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2024-01-01 00:00:00+00'
    AND session_start < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
  GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', session_start) AS DATE)
)
SELECT m.month, m.sessions, COALESCE(p.sessions, 0) AS sessions_prev_year
FROM monthly m
LEFT JOIN monthly p ON p.month = m.month - INTERVAL 1 YEAR
WHERE m.month >= DATE '2025-01-01'

solver.query:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', session_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS month, COUNT(*) AS sessions
  FROM sessions
  WHERE (session_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND (session_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT cur.month, cur.sessions, COALESCE(prev.sessions, 0) AS sessions_prev_year
FROM m cur
LEFT JOIN m prev ON prev.month = CAST(cur.month - INTERVAL 1 YEAR AS DATE)
WHERE cur.month >= DATE '2025-01-01'
